title: A thought experiment
label: Ten times the throws, scattered off the bull

imagine-your-organization-as-a-line.title: Imagine your organization as a line
imagine-your-organization-as-a-line.script: AI doesn't build the right swing for you, but it can build the wrong one ten times faster. Imagine your own organization as a factory line, with documents moving from one work center to the next, a request here, a design there, a finished result at the end. You already know this picture. Everyone in this room has seen the old cartoon where the customer asks for a tire swing and gets a tangle of ropes, because each station built its own version of what the customer asked for.

where-this-is-going.title: Where this is going
where-this-is-going.script: Before we start, here is the route. First we give every station on that line an AI and watch what happens. Then we look at what you hand the AI, because that decides the result. And last, you will see how an AI interview builds that handover for you, so you do not have to write it alone.
